report: 图像中的微噪声水平较高，但没有明显的伪造迹象。

evidence.phenomenon: Whole-image noise-residual level 4.7513: the camera end of the G2 calibration band. Residual consistent with a camera sensor; a band is an association measured on the calibration set, not a physical proof of origin.
evidence.reasoning: Whole-image residual micro-noise level 4.7513 (high). The G2 calibration set associates this band with camera capture: sensor noise that survives re-encoding. High residual does NOT indicate forgery — that is the original reading this expert was calibrated against — and sharpening inflates the metric with no sensor involved.
evidence.interpretation_text: Calibration: this measurement band corresponds to camera-source statistics (P(Fake)=0.11); the benign reading applies.
evidence.counter_explanation: 该指标衡量残差水平而非"不一致性"：G2 校准（格式配平，5 格）显示 Real 中位数 3.6 对 Fake 2.0，方向与原始"异常即伪造"的解释相反，且跨格式稳定（AUROC 0.15-0.23）。降噪、锐化与重压缩同样会改变该水平，故只应作为弱证据与校准似然配合使用。
evidence.applicability_conditions: 高 strength 统计上对应 Real（JPEG 压缩引入方差），不得按 AI-generated 解读；低 strength 侧（P(Fake)≈0.8）可作为弱证据使用。
evidence.interpretation_text_raw: High residual micro-noise level — spatially rich sensor noise of the kind the calibration set associates with camera capture.
